alignment_check.method: All 125 source/English pairs read; corrected 637:l013–014 clause allocation. All three PDF pages visually compared. One formula unresolved, separately preserved and not counted.

unresolved_passages.note: Yudakhin кырым II establishes excellent workmanship in gun descriptions: https://el-sozduk.kg/кырым/ (direct HTTP retrieved after web tool failed). Its parallel reads түбү Кытай кырымы, but this PDF visibly has кылым. The remaining phrase is unresolved; no silent Кытай substitution or invented Crimean origin. Comparative study https://arch.kyrlibnet.kg/uploads/TALGUAITALIEVA2013.pdf PDF124 repeats our wording without explaining it.
